entry.title: Paradiso Elegancia Corona — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Coffee, café au lait, toasted nuts
Occasion: Lighter daytime smoke, relaxed afternoon
entry.summaryHtml: Cream, toasted nuts, cedar, café au lait, sweet grass and mild pepper make the Elegancia Corona the softer member of the Paradiso family. Its Ecuador Connecticut wrapper smooths the Nicaraguan core into wheat toast and light leather, while the 46-ring Corona keeps enough pepper and wood in the finish to avoid flattening out.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar Hut lists the exact 5.5″ × 46 Paradiso Elegancia Corona single at A$37.
productionLines: Handmade in Nicaragua by My Father
